targets.quote: The objective is to at least double the annual energy renovation rate of residential and non-residential buildings by 2030 and to foster deep energy renovations.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Mobilising forces at all levels towards these goals will result in 35 million building units renovated by 2030.
targets.label: target

targets.quote: The increased rate and depth of renovation will have to be maintained also post-2030 in order to reach EU-wide climate neutrality by 2050.
targets.article: Climate neutrality of building stock by 2050
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: to cut net greenhouse gas emissions in the EU by at least 55% by 2030 compared to 1990.
targets.article: EU net GHG cut of at least 55% by 2030
targets.label: target

targets.quote: by 2030 the EU should reduce buildings’ greenhouse gas emissions by 60%, their final energy consumption by 14% and energy consumption for heating and cooling by 18%
targets.label: target

targets.quote: By 2030 an additional 160 000 green jobs could be created in the EU construction sector through a renovation wave
targets.label: target

targets.quote: in order to achieve the proposed 55% climate target by 2030, around EUR 275 billion of additional investments are needed per year
targets.article: EUR 275 billion additional annual renovation investment
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The annual rate of replacement of heating equipment would have to reach around 4% in both the residential and services sector. During the same time period, the share of renewables and waste heat would have to increase to 38-42%
targets.article: Heating equipment replacement ~4%/yr; renewables & waste heat 38-42%
targets.label: target

targets.quote: the Commission will propose mandatory minimum energy performance standards as part of the revision of the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive (EPBD) by the end of 2021
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: the Commission will propose by June 2021 the need to extend the scope of the requirements to all public administration levels and to increase the annual renovation obligation as part of the revision of the EED.
targets.article: Extend public-building renovation requirement to all levels
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: indicative milestones for the renovation of public and private service buildings for 2030 and 2040 with a view to decarbonising the building stock by 2050.
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: it will develop by 2023 a roadmap leading up to 2050 for reducing whole life-cycle carbon emissions in buildings.
targets.article: 2050 roadmap for whole life-cycle carbon of buildings
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote:
With nearly 34 million Europeans unable to afford keeping their home adequately warm
65
, tackling energy poverty is an urgent task for the EU and its Member States.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Each year, 800 000 social homes need renovation, requiring an estimated EUR 57 billion of additional funding
targets.article: 800 000 social homes needing renovation per year
targets.label: other

targets.quote: three areas deserve specific attention: a) tackling energy poverty and worst-performing buildings; b) renovating public buildings, such as administrative, educational and healthcare facilities and c) decarbonising heating and cooling.
targets.article: Three priority focus areas for renovation
targets.label: objective
